# Getting help

- Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/SonyDew/slipstream/discussions) for setup
  questions, deployment advice and general conversation.
- Use the issue templates for reproducible bugs and scoped feature requests.
- For a security vulnerability, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting. Do not
  disclose credentials, session cookies or token-bearing source URLs in a public post.

Before opening a report, update yt-dlp and check
[the troubleshooting guide](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md). Source platforms change often,
and an extractor update is frequently the complete fix.
